title: Rainwater Harvesting Studio: A parametric roof and tank sizing tool
description:
A single-file, dependency-free parametric 3D modeller that calculates rainwater harvesting yield, store capacity and reliability to BS EN 16941-1:2024. Built for teaching architecture students.

The roof is modelled in 3D and the catchment is taken as its horizontal projection, so pitch changes the surface area without changing what is collected. Yield follows Formula (1) of clause 6.1.2 with the Table 2 run-off coefficients; store operation follows Annex A.2.2.3, and capacity the dry-period method of A.2.1 with the BSI UK National Annex NA.3.

Rainfall for the 28 preset cities is sourced, not assumed: twenty-two from the WMO Climatological Standard Normals 1991-2020 (NOAA NCEI Accession 0253808 v6.6, CC0 1.0, https://doi.org/10.25921/800j-vn07) and six from the WMO World Weather Information Service. Every city's source, station, WMO station number, elevation, period and rain-day threshold is recorded in docs/climate-source.json.

Acknowledgement must be given to the WMO World Weather Information Service (https://worldweather.wmo.int) as the source of information; the forecast and climatological information of the WWIS website must be reproduced accurately.

The software is MIT. The documentation, screenshots and exercises are CC BY 4.0.
